scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:deploy
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix mobile install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.ios: concurrently -n server,ios -c magenta,green "npm:dev:server" "npm --prefix mobile run ios"
scripts.android: concurrently -n server,android -c magenta,green "npm:dev:server" "npm --prefix mobile run android"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix mobile run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix mobile test && npm --prefix server test
